situations.headline: Takeovers Panel extends interim freeze on Forrestania's bid for Zenith Minerals pending final orders

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Takeovers Panel extends interim freeze on Forrestania's bid for Zenith Minerals pending final orders (interest 5, risk 5)

thesis.text: Zenith Minerals is subject to a contested off-market takeover bid from Forrestania Resources, now under active Takeovers Panel scrutiny after unacceptable circumstances were declared; the Panel's interim orders freeze bid acceptance processing and extend the offer period until final determination, meaning deal timing and terms remain highly uncertain until the Panel rules, likely within the next two months [asx:5ff017c66d40bb77822dd2ffd26bddda p.1].
